about: Secret Message (Nov 25), a speaking game for two teams: the first student of each line sees a secret sentence (direct or reported statement/question), whispers it down the line, and the last student says it the other way. 60 phrases per level (30 pairs, both directions). Each item: k = ds/dq/rs/rq (what the secret IS), say = the secret, answer = the model conversion (words in brackets are optional). Nov 25: each level also has 50 `twisters` (25 short tongue twisters of at most 5 words, k = tt, and 25 hard words or phrases, k = hw) that are said exactly the same (answer = say); the menu picks Reported speech, Tongue twisters or Both.

intro.title: Secret Message
text: Two teams whisper a secret sentence down the line.
The first student gets it. The last student must say it the other way!

intro.title: Who is picked?
text: Stand in a line with your team, in any order.
The spinner picks the front and the back student!

rows: Reporter: says it the other way

intro.title: Whisper it down
text: The Messenger sees the secret for a few seconds.
Whisper it to the next student, and the next...

intro.title: Say it the other way
text: Direct becomes reported. Reported becomes direct.
Questions too! Watch the verbs and the word order.

intro.title: Points
text: Right answer: +1 point for the team!

intro.title: Tongue twisters
text: Twister mode: whisper it down the line, then say it EXACTLY the same.
Hard words and short tongue twisters. Speak clearly!
